statement: ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M), Actions lam (kop K M x) (kop K M y) (kop K M h) B
proof:
classical
let S : Subring (Module.End ℂ V) :=
  { carrier := {f | Stable M f}
    zero_mem' := by intro w hw; simpa using M.zero_mem
    one_mem' := by intro w hw; simpa using hw
    add_mem' := by intro f g hf hg w hw; exact M.add_mem (hf w hw) (hg w hw)
    neg_mem' := by intro f hf w hw; exact M.neg_mem (hf w hw)
    mul_mem' := by intro f g hf hg w hw; exact hf _ (hg w hw) }
let res : S →+* Module.End ℤ M :=
  { toFun := fun f => (f.val.restrictScalars ℤ).restrict f.property
    map_zero' := by ext w; rfl
    map_one' := by ext w; rfl
    map_add' := by intro f g; ext w; rfl
    map_mul' := by intro f g; ext w; rfl }
have hres (f : Module.End ℂ V) (hf : Stable M f) :
    res ⟨f, hf⟩ = latticeOp M f := by
  simp [res, latticeOp, hf]

have hx : Stable M x := by simpa [dp] using (h_H005.2 1).1
have hy : Stable M y := by simpa [dp] using (h_H005.2 1).2
have hh : Stable M h := by
  intro w hw
  rw [← h_H003.2.2]
  exact M.sub_mem (hx _ (hy w hw)) (hy _ (hx w hw))
let X : S := ⟨x, hx⟩
let Y : S := ⟨y, hy⟩
let H : S := ⟨h, hh⟩
let F : S →+* Module.End K (VK K M) :=
  (Module.End.baseChangeHom ℤ K M).toRingHom.comp res
have hF (f : Module.End ℂ V) (hf : Stable M f) :
    F ⟨f, hf⟩ = kop K M f := by
  change (res ⟨f, hf⟩).baseChange K = _
  rw [hres]; rfl

have hFsub (a b : S) : F (a - b) = F a - F b :=
  map_sub (G := S) (H := Module.End K (VK K M)) F a b
have hFmul (a b : S) : F (a * b) = F a * F b := map_mul F a b
have hFz (n : ℤ) (a : S) : F (n • a) = n • F a :=
  map_zsmul (G := S) (H := Module.End K (VK K M)) F n a
have hxy : X * Y - Y * X = H := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact h_H003.2.2
have hhx : H * X - X * H = (2 : ℤ) • X := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change h * x - x * h = (2 : ℤ) • x
  simpa only [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℂ, Int.cast_ofNat] using h_H003.1
have hhy : H * Y - Y * H = (-2 : ℤ) • Y := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change h * y - y * h = (-2 : ℤ) • y
  simpa only [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℂ, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_ofNat] using h_H003.2.1
have hbr1 : kop K M h = kop K M x * kop K M y - kop K M y * kop K M x := by
  have eqn := (congrArg F hxy).symm
  rw [hFsub, hFmul, hFmul] at eqn
  simpa only [X, Y, H, hF] using eqn
have hbr2 : kop K M h * kop K M x - kop K M x * kop K M h = (2 : K) • kop K M x := by
  have eqn := congrArg F hhx
  rw [hFsub, hFmul, hFmul, hFz] at eqn
  simpa only [X, H, hF, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, Int.cast_ofNat] using eqn
have hbr3 : kop K M h * kop K M y - kop K M y * kop K M h = (-2 : K) • kop K M y := by
  have eqn := congrArg F hhy
  rw [hFsub, hFmul, hFmul, hFz] at eqn
  simpa only [Y, H, hF, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_ofNat] using eqn

letI : CharP K p := h_H001.2.1
have hlp : lam.toNat < p := by omega
have hfac (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ lam.toNat) : (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [Ne, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff K p, h_H001.1.dvd_factorial]
  omega
have hFn (n : ℕ) (a : S) : F (n • a) = n • F a :=
  map_nsmul (G := S) (H := Module.End K (VK K M)) F n a
have hFp (a : S) (r : ℕ) : F (a ^ r) = F a ^ r := map_pow F a r
have hdiv (f : Module.End ℂ V) (hf : Stable M f) (r : ℕ)
    (hd : Stable M (dp f r)) (hr : r ≤ lam.toNat) :
    (latticeOp M (dp f r)).baseChange K = kdp (kop K M f) r := by
  let Q : S := ⟨f, hf⟩
  let D : S := ⟨dp f r, hd⟩
  have heq : r.factorial • D = Q ^ r := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change r.factorial • dp f r = f ^ r
    rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℂ, dp, smul_smul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero r)), one_smul]
  have eqn := congrArg F heq
  rw [hFn, hFp] at eqn
  have heqK : (r.factorial : K) • kop K M (dp f r) = kop K M f ^ r := by
    simpa only [Q, D, hF, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul] using eqn
  change kop K M (dp f r) = _
  calc
    _ = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • ((r.factorial : K) • kop K M (dp f r)) :=
      (inv_smul_smul₀ (hfac r hr) _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [heqK]; rfl
have hdx (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ lam.toNat) :
    (latticeOp M (dp x r)).baseChange K = kdp (kop K M x) r :=
  hdiv x hx r (h_H005.2 r).1 hr
have hdy (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ lam.toNat) :
    (latticeOp M (dp y r)).baseChange K = kdp (kop K M y) r :=
  hdiv y hy r (h_H005.2 r).2 hr

rcases h_T012 with ⟨rho, hdata⟩
letI : Algebra (R p) K := rho.toAlgebra
rcases hdata with ⟨phi, hphi0, hphi, b, hb, BR, hBR, B, hB, hAct⟩
let T : Module.End (R p) (MR p M) →+* Module.End K (VK K M) :=
  (phi.symm.conjRingEquiv.toRingHom).comp
    (Module.End.baseChangeHom (R p) K (MR p M)).toRingHom
have hT (f : Module.End (R p) (MR p M)) (z : VK K M) :
    phi (T f z) = f.baseChange K (phi z) := by
  change phi (phi.symm (f.baseChange K (phi z))) = _
  exact phi.apply_symm_apply _
have hTx (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ lam.toNat) :
    T (rop p M (dp x r)) = kdp (kop K M x) r := by
  rw [← hdx r hr]
  change T (rop p M (dp x r)) = kop K M (dp x r)
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply phi.injective
  rw [hT, hphi _ (h_H005.2 r).1]
  rfl
have hTy (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ lam.toNat) :
    T (rop p M (dp y r)) = kdp (kop K M y) r := by
  rw [← hdy r hr]
  change T (rop p M (dp y r)) = kop K M (dp y r)
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply phi.injective
  rw [hT, hphi _ (h_H005.2 r).2]
  rfl
have hTmul (f g : Module.End (R p) (MR p M)) : T (f*g) = T f * T g :=
  map_mul T f g
rcases h_T004.2.2.1 with ⟨BC, hBC⟩
have hcompat := h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.1
have hmuX (r : ℕ) (z : MR p M) :
    mu p M (rop p M (dp x r) z) = dp x r (mu p M z) := (hcompat r).1 z
have hmuY (r : ℕ) (z : MR p M) :
    mu p M (rop p M (dp y r) z) = dp y r (mu p M z) := (hcompat r).2 z
have hBR' (k : Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) : mu p M (BR k) = b • BC k := by
  rw [hBR, hBC]
exact ⟨B, hAct⟩

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type u_1) [fieldK : Field K] (lam : ℤ) (V : Type u_2) [addV : AddCommGroup V]
  [moduleV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ lam ∧ lam < ↑p →
    h * x - x * h = 2 • x ∧ h * y - y * h = -2 • y ∧ x * y - y * x = h →
      ((∃ d bZ bC, ∀ (i : Fin d), bC i = ↑(bZ i)) ∧ ∀ (r : ℕ), Stable M (dp x r) ∧ Stable M (dp y r)) →
        ComplexOutput lam x y h v →
          MatrixOutput p lam M x y v →
            PrincipalOutput p lam M y v →
              ScalarExtensionData p K M →
                ReducedBasisData p K lam M x y h v → ∃ B, Actions lam (kop K M x) (kop K M y) (kop K M h) B
